Job Search CRM.context: My own job-search platform, deployed on a cloud VM and used daily in my real job search
notes: I have been looking for a job for more than two years in a tough market, and new government rule changes kept forcing me to adapt, sometimes several times within a few days. It felt overwhelming.
I wanted something that would ease the search. When I looked for tools, most were fake, unfinished, unproductive or simply failed.
So I built it myself, aiming to solve most of those problems while keeping it mostly free for people who need it.

TalentVenue EventIntel.context: Capstone project for the ElevateMe Bootcamp data analytics certificate, built on the bootcamp's real business data
notes: The bootcamp's capstone gave me a real event and talent-management company's database with real problems to solve.

Reports recalculated money totals contract by contract every time they were read, payments could not easily be checked against the accounting ledger, 14.7% of contracts were cancelled, and tax ID and bank account numbers sat in ordinary tables.
I built it to learn: to take my skills to the next level and understand how the whole system fits together, not just one piece.
With AI changing how everything gets done, I believe an engineer has to keep adapting and stay broad; if you can't keep up, nothing else is worth much.

Clinical Trials.context: Personal portfolio project on de-identified clinical trial outcomes
notes: My motivation came from COVID: how the world changed before and after it, and wanting to learn more about the medical industry.
During the second wave in India, fake news and fear spread chaos and made the situation much worse.

I understood it happened because ordinary people lacked clarity on how things work and basic knowledge of the illness, so I turned that thought into a project and tried to build something in that direction.
